title: Harden the restart block against malformed handoffs
body:
Outcome: the restart block refuses the malformed handoffs PR #154's third review found (record .krn/runs/review-series/92fa2cf048b8807854c904b12c169358d720619288484b62ab5ee5ff4aca341c/records/3.json): (1) control characters in command fields, or a block whose JSON serialization would push the SessionStart context past its cap, are refused; (2) an open operator request bullet must be exactly - "<verbatim words>": <task id|memory:slug>, with the id outside the quote; (3) headings inside fenced code do not end the operator-requests section in scripts/claude/handoff-block.ts, and a fenced section makes the hook report the handoff invalid instead of injecting part of it.
Proof: a new observer test file fails at the current main by assertion for each case and passes at head.
